title: KryloSMP Official Network Rules

rules.title: Respect & Fair Play
rules.desc: Treat all players, staff, and creators with mutual respect. Zero tolerance for harassment, racism, homophobia, toxicity, or hate speech.

rules.title: No Spam or Self-Promotion
rules.desc: Advertising other servers, unsolicited DMs, repetitive chat spam, and referral links are strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Account & Security
rules.desc: You are fully responsible for your account. Compromised accounts, ban evasion with alt accounts, and sharing logins are not permitted.

rules.title: No Hacking or Unfair Advantages
rules.desc: X-Ray texture packs, Killaura, Fly, Speed, Auto-clickers (>15 CPS), Baritone bots, and unapproved mods are banned.

rules.title: No Bug Abuse or Duplication
rules.desc: Exploiting game glitches, item duping, crash exploits, or glitching through world borders is strictly forbidden. Disclose bugs in #support for rewards.

rules.title: Combat & Combat-Logging
rules.desc: Disconnecting, teleporting, or quitting while in active PvP combat triggers automatic death and heart loss via our combat tag engine.

rules.title: Trap & Spawn Etiquette
rules.desc: Spawn trapping portals, killing players immediately at neutral hub warps, or building lag machines is prohibited.

rules.title: Real Money Trading (RMT) Policy
rules.desc: Trading in-game items, hearts, or KryloCoins (KC) for real-world currency outside official web links is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Fair Trading & Scamming
rules.desc: Scamming players during agreed item trades or auction transactions is punishable.

discord_synced_desc:
Welcome to **KryloSMP**! To ensure a safe, fun, and competitive environment for all players, please review and agree to our server rules:

1️⃣ **Respect & Fair Play:** Treat all members and staff with respect. No harassment, hate speech, or toxicity.
2️⃣ **No Cheating / Exploits:** X-Ray, fly hacks, auto-clickers, and duping are strictly forbidden and result in permanent bans.
3️⃣ **No Spam or Self-Promotion:** Keep discussions relevant to each channel.
4️⃣ **Clan & PvP Integrity:** Follow designated combat zones and clan raid protocols.
5️⃣ **Staff Authority:** Staff decisions are final. If you have questions, open a ticket.

*Click the button below to accept the rules and unlock chat access!*
